title: Captions of a clip move with it when a freeze moves only its track
goal: When a person freezes a frame on one track (the new default), the captions transcribed from that clip should move along with the clip, so the words stay under the person speaking. Today they stay where they were and drift out of step by the length of the freeze.
notes: Seen in freeze-frame-asks-how-long-walk picture 2 (2026-10-17): Sample Talk frozen 10s at 0:03 with This track; the Captions track cues stayed at 8s while the clip they transcribe moved to 18s, and the cue across 0:03 reads 10s out. Captions carry no link to the clip they were heard off (grep captionSource in PhotonzCore finds nothing), so HoldPush.pushHeldTime(.thisTrack) only sees layerIDs(onTracks: [the clip track]). Premiere moves captions only with sync lock; here they are the clip's own words, which a person expects to follow it.
acceptance: Freeze a talking clip for 10 s at 0:03 with Freeze every track off: every caption cue and word from that clip after 0:03 starts 10 s later, and the cue across 0:03 waits through the freeze
Music and other clips on other tracks still run on under the freeze
Captions from another clip on another track do not move
A walk shows it, with the caption drift mark gone from the clip's own captions
